searchText: Hey, do you have any test cases for invalid witness? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v0.4.1 has a couple of them where are the source of these tests? I am not sure, you might have some luck trying to take a look at release branch's history. https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/tests-zkevm%40v0.4.1/tests/amsterdam/eip8025_optional_proofs reg the "invalid" most cases you can usually find them in the `tests_witness_validation_*.py` files (there might be extra concrete ones in other files too; but always in that folder)
